assets.protected_center: must remain open for units and traps

assets.affordance: irregular mountain silhouette; no complete playable diamond
layered cliff shelf; no grid line or playable face
distant angular peak; lower contrast than playable terrain
broken mist bank; no playable face center
one noninteractive mountain panorama; no outside-map grid or deployable face

assets.clearance: face center, emergence approach, overlays, and contact region remain exposed
open arc silhouette; face center, route approach, HP/leak attachments, overlays, and contact region remain exposed

assets.placement: only on later validated non-path anchors; never baked into terrain

assets.semantics: neutral cadence only; no reserved colors and no hue-only dependence

palette_policy.note: Candidate colors are original shell-lime, chalk, bleached timber, canvas, ceramic, service-metal, umber, and dark separators; no live-site swatches are copied.

generation.reference_policy: Only Agent D owner-approved generated concepts are used as identity references.
generation.post_generation: deterministic keying, connected-component crop, nearest resample, palette quantization without dither, hard alpha, geometry/pivot/reserved-color QA
